ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a blue square-wave signal on a grid background, and the pulse repeats periodically. Observing one complete repeated pulse, the horizontal distance from one rising edge to the next rising edge is about 8 small grids; within the same period, from the rising edge to the subsequent falling edge, that is, the high-level duration, is about 3 small grids. Reasoning calculation: duty cycle = high-level duration / period × 100% = 3 / 8 × 100% = 37.5%. Taking an approximate value as required by the question, it is about 38.0%.

raw_record.question_text: Determine the duty cycle of this square wave signal, as shown in the figure. The duty cycle is ______%.

method.method_draft: Inspect the plotted waveform first, focusing on one repeated pulse. Measure horizontally on the grid from a rising edge to the next rising edge to get the period, then measure from the rising edge to the following falling edge to get the on-time. Compute duty cycle as on-time divided by period times 100: approximately 3 minor divisions high out of 8 minor divisions per cycle, so (3/8)×100 ≈ 37.5%, reported as 38.0%.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是在网格背景上的蓝色方波信号，脉冲周期性重复。观察其中一个完整重复脉冲，从一个上升沿到下一个上升沿的水平距离约为 8 个小格；同一周期内，从上升沿到随后的下降沿，即高电平持续时间，约为 3 个小格。
推理计算：占空比 = 高电平持续时间 / 周期 × 100% = 3 / 8 × 100% = 37.5%。按题目要求取近似值，约为 38.0%。
